# BO - Monitoring page  - An exception is displayed when we try to enable a product with empty Name

With Product V2, we can create a disabled product with an empty name
In the BO > Catalog > Monitoring page, when we try to enable it, An exception is displayed

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/201667855-6138eab3-7297-4a12-83ae-974e312a3338.png)

## Attendu
An alert is displayed: we cannot enable a product with an empty name 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/201668519-a3ce8ca5-3393-4646-8f0d-a6549de972db.png)

## Étapes
1. Go to BO > Advanced Parameters > New & Experimental Features page & enable New product page - Single store
2. Go to BO > Catalog > Products V2
3. Create a disabled product with an empty name
4. Go to BO > Catalog > Monitoring page
5. Try to enable the last product created
6. See error

It can't be reproduced with PS1.7.8.7
